# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Go tests pass
- [ ] Relevant Rust tests/lints pass
- [ ] Relevant web tests/build pass
- [ ] Documentation is updated when setup or behavior changed
- [ ] No local config, secrets, databases, story data, or generated artifacts are included

## Compatibility

Describe storage migrations, protocol changes, or deployment impact. Write
`None` when there is no compatibility impact.
